business_problem: Natura, a trailblazing Brazilian multinational cosmetics company, has dedicated themselves to sustainable development since their founding in 1969. With a mission to create products that enhance the well-being of the individual, community and planet, Natura works directly with communities in the Amazonian region and pioneered a carbon-neutral business strategy.
solution_summary: Natura built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Lakeflow Jobs, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.
